name: io.github.SuperAngryMonkey/cdeck
description: Pair with the CDeck Apple TV dashboard app and push an end-to-end encrypted deck of stats, lists and calendar from your own connectors.

environmentVariables.name: CDECK_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: cdeck-api base URL. Defaults to https://cdeck.happymonkey.dev (the public instance). Point it at your own if you self-host.

environmentVariables.name: CDECK_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where push tokens and the audit log live. Defaults to ~/.config/cdeck.
